question: What is the geometric mean of the monthly outlays (in nominal dollars) of the US judiciary from January 1984 to March 1987? Report the number in millions rounded to the nearest thousandth.
raw_response:
Found the data in Treasury Bulletin Table FFO-3 "On-budget and Off-budget Outlays by Agency" (in millions of dollars), column "The Judiciary". Using overlapping quarterly issues (1984_06 through 1987_06) and cross-checking each month across multiple issues to weed out column-misalignment artifacts, the 39 monthly values Jan 1984 – Mar 1987 are:

1984: 84, 89, 63, 74, 62, 93, 65, 79, 69, 79, 67, 96
1985: 66, 60, 99, 119, 75, 63, 74, 103, 66, 98, 74, 102
1986: 76, 108, 74, 129, 75, 71, 70, 106, 87, 73, 73, 118
1987: 78, 76, 110

Geometric mean = exp(mean(ln(values))) = 81.4058... ≈ 81.406 million.

<FINAL_ANSWER>81.406</FINAL_ANSWER>
